entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about an order I received last week. I'd like to start a return for the Aero Road Helmet I purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your order number please?

Thank you. I see the order here for the Aero Road Helmet in Solar Flare Red, delivered four days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's just a preference. There's nothing wrong with it. In fact, the box is unopened. The color just doesn't quite match my bike the way I thought it would from the pictures online.

I understand completely. Getting the right color match is important. Since the helmet was delivered just a few days ago and it's not a wearable electronic like our VeloBand, it falls well within our 90-day return policy.
Excellent. So I can get a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending an email to the address on file right now. It will contain a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack it up, attach the label, and drop it at any courier location. Once we receive it, we'll process your full refund.

That's great, thank you. I appreciate how easy that is. Now, since I am going to be ordering a different helmet, and considering the inconvenience of having to send this one back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? Maybe 10% or so?

I understand you're looking for the best value on your next purchase. However, our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on returns related to color preference. We do cover the full cost of the return shipping for you, so there are no out-of-pocket expenses to send it back.

I see. Not even a 5% credit? I'm a loyal customer and I plan on buying the replacement immediately. It just seems like a reasonable request to ensure I stick with VeloFit for my next helmet, especially since safety is my top priority and I trust your brand.

I truly appreciate your loyalty, and we're glad you trust VeloFit for your safety on the road. While I can't offer a monetary discount, I can assure you that your refund will be processed the same day the helmet arrives at our warehouse. That way, you'll have the funds back as quickly as possible for your new purchase. The best I can do is get this return processed efficiently for you.
Alright, fair enough. I had to ask. As long as the return is straightforward, I'm happy. Thanks for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. The email with the label has been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a good day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
